records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues decreased 1.2% for the three months ended September 30, 2023, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: One-Way Truckload continued to be challenged by overall market conditions with less freight available, elevated exposure to transactional spot rates, significant pricing pressure, and rapidly rising fuel prices in third quarter 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Expense items that impacted the overall operating ratio are described on the following pages.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During third quarter 2023, One-Way Truckload average revenues per total mile, net of fuel surcharge decreased 4.8%, as One-Way Truckload remained challenged by elevated transactional spot exposure and ongoing pricing pressure.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Werner Logistics operating income decreased to $2.0 million in third quarter 2023 from $5.1 million in third quarter 2022, due to rate compression, new business implementations, and higher operating expenses.
